blocks.text: 37-darsda **there is / there are** — «hozir ... bor» — o'tildi. O'zbekchada «bor» boshqa zamonlarda ham ishlatiladi: «bor **edi**», «bo'l**di**», «bo'l**adi**». Ingliz tilida esa **there** o'zgarmaydi, faqat **be** fe'li zamonga qarab o'zgaradi: **there was** (o'tmish), **there has been** (Present Perfect), **there will be** (kelajak). Shuning uchun bu darsdagi hamma narsa siz bilgan zamonlarning **be** shakllariga tayanadi.

O'tmishda biror joyda nimadir bo'lgani — **there was** (birlik va sanalmaydigan ot) yoki **there were** (ko'plik): **There was** a cat in the garden. **There were** a lot of people. Voqealar haqida ham shunday: **There was** a storm last night — «Kecha kechasi bo'ron bo'ldi». Inkor — **there wasn't / there weren't** yoki **there was no** ..., savol — **Was there** ...? / **Were there** ...?, qisqa javob — Yes, there **was**. / No, there **weren't**. was / were tanlovi xuddi 10-darsdagidek.

items.text: **There was** a party at Aziz's house on Saturday.
**There weren't** any taxis at the station.
**Were there** many people at the market? — Yes, **there were**.

blocks.text: there has been / there have been

Present Perfect (→ 15-dars) bilan: **there has been** (birlik), **there have been** (ko'plik). Qisqa shakli — **there's been**. U ikki holatda ishlatiladi. Birinchisi — yangi voqea, uning natijasi hozir muhim: **There's been** an accident! — «Avariya bo'libdi!». Ikkinchisi — hozirgacha davom etayotgan davr: this week, this year, recently, since ..., for ...: **There have been** a lot of problems this year. Savol — **Has there been** ...? / **Have there been** ...?

items.text: **There's been** a lot of rain this week.
**Have there been** any messages for me?

blocks.text: **there was** va **there has been** farqi Past Simple va Present Perfect farqi bilan bir xil (→ 20-dars): tugagan vaqt (yesterday, last year, in 2015, ... ago) bo'lsa — **there was**; hozirgacha davom etayotgan vaqt (this year, since Monday, recently) bo'lsa — **there has been**.

rows: **There have been** three storms this month.

blocks.text: Kelajak uchun — **there will be** (qisqa shakli **there'll be**), birlik va ko'plikda bir xil: **There will be** a test on Friday. **There will be** two tests next week. Inkor — **there won't be**, savol — **Will there be** ...? — Yes, **there will**. / No, **there won't**. Reja yoki aniq belgi bo'lsa, **there's going to be** ham ishlatiladi (→ 26-dars): Look at the clouds — **there's going to be** a storm.

items.text: **There will be** a test on Friday.
**Will there be** a break in the middle of the concert? — Yes, **there will**.

blocks.text: **there** modal fe'llar bilan ham ishlatiladi, undan keyin doim **be**: **There might be** a problem. — «Muammo bo'lishi mumkin» (29-dars); **There must be** a mistake. — «Albatta xato bor»; **There used to be** a cinema here. — «Bu yerda ilgari kinoteatr bor edi» (36-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «There was many people.» → **There were a lot of people.**; «There were a lot of rain.» → **There was a lot of rain.** (rain — sanalmaydigan); «It was a big storm yesterday.» → **There was a big storm yesterday.**; «Will be a party?» → **Will there be a party?**; «There will have a meeting.» → **There will be a meeting.**; «There has been an accident yesterday.» → **There was an accident yesterday.**

Eslab qolish: **there** joyida qoladi, faqat **be** o'zgaradi — is → **was**, are → **were**, → **has / have been**, → **will be**. Savolda **be** (yoki yordamchi fe'l) **there** dan oldinga chiqadi: **Was there** ...? **Has there been** ...? **Will there be** ...?

examples.title: **There was** / **There were**: in the past
examples.description: O'tmishda: **there was** (birlik, sanalmaydigan) va **there were** (ko'plik) = «... bor edi», «... bo'ldi».

sentences.text: **There was** a big storm last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi kuchli bo'ron **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: When we arrived, **there were** a lot of people at the station.
sentences.translation: Biz yetib kelganimizda vokzalda odam juda **ko'p edi**.

sentences.text: In my grandfather's village **there was** only one shop.
sentences.translation: Bobomning qishlog'ida faqat bitta do'kon **bor edi**.

sentences.text: **There were** twenty guests at Aziz's birthday party.
sentences.translation: Azizning tug'ilgan kunida yigirmata mehmon **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday **there was** a football match on TV, so the streets were empty.
sentences.translation: Kecha televizorda futbol o'yini **bo'ldi**, shuning uchun ko'chalar bo'm-bo'sh edi.

sentences.text: Ten years ago **there were** only fields here.
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin bu yerda faqat dalalar **bor edi**.

sentences.text: On the table **there was** a note from Mum.
sentences.translation: Stol ustida oyimdan qolgan xat **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm late — **there was** a lot of traffic.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kechikdim — yo'lda tirbandlik **bor edi**.

sentences.text: At the concert **there were** musicians from five different countries.
sentences.translation: Konsertda besh xil davlatdan kelgan musiqachilar **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Last winter **there was** so much snow in Tashkent that the schools closed for two days.
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish Toshkentda shunchalik ko'p qor **yog'diki**, maktablar ikki kunga yopildi.

examples.title: **wasn't** / **weren't**; **Was there** ...? **Were there** ...?
examples.description: O'tmishda inkor: **there wasn't / weren't**, **there was no** ... («yo'q edi»). Savol: **Was there** ...? **Were there** ...? («bormidi?», «ko'p edimi?»).

sentences.text: **There wasn't** any milk, so I drank my tea black.
sentences.translation: Sut **yo'q edi**, shuning uchun choyni sutsiz ichdim.

sentences.text: **Was there** a lot of traffic this morning? — No, **there wasn't**.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab yo'lda tirbandlik **bormidi**? — Yo'q, **bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: In the old flat **there weren't** enough cupboards.
sentences.translation: Eski kvartirada shkaflar **yetarli emas edi**.

sentences.text: **Were there** many students at the lecture? — Yes, **there were**. The hall was full.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzada talabalar **ko'p edimi**? — Ha, **ko'p edi**. Zal to'la edi.

sentences.text: Sorry, **there was no** answer when I called you.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qo'ng'iroq qilganimda hech kim **javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: How many people **were there** at the wedding? — About three hundred!
sentences.translation: To'yda necha kishi **bor edi**? — Uch yuzga yaqin!

sentences.text: Madina, **was there** a message for me? — Yes, Tom called.
sentences.translation: Madina, menga xabar **bormidi**? — Ha, Tom qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: At that time **there weren't** any mobile phones.
sentences.translation: U paytda mobil telefonlar **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: **Was there** anything interesting in the newspaper today?
sentences.translation: Bugungi gazetada qiziq biror narsa **bormidi**?

sentences.text: We went to the beach, but **there wasn't** anywhere to sit.
sentences.translation: Biz plyajga bordik, lekin o'tiradigan joy **yo'q edi**.

examples.title: Then and now: **there was** ↔ **there is**
examples.description: O'tmish va hozir yonma-yon: **there was / were** — «bor edi», **there is / are** — «hozir bor». Tasdiq va inkor juftliklari.

sentences.text: **There was** a small shop here; now **there's** a big supermarket.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda kichik do'kon **bor edi**, endi katta supermarket **bor**.

sentences.text: When I was a child, **there were** no computers in our school. Now **there are** thirty.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda maktabimizda kompyuterlar **yo'q edi**. Hozir o'ttizta **bor**.

sentences.text: Yesterday **there were** clouds everywhere, but today **there isn't** a cloud in the sky.
sentences.translation: Kecha hamma yoqni bulut **qoplagan edi**, bugun esa osmonda bitta ham bulut **yo'q**.

sentences.text: In the past **there was** a river here, but now **there's** a road.
sentences.translation: Ilgari bu yerda daryo **bor edi**, hozir esa yo'l **bor**.

sentences.text: Last year **there were** three British students in our group. This year **there's** only one.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili guruhimizda uchta britaniyalik talaba **bor edi**. Bu yil faqat bittasi **bor**.

sentences.text: **There's** a lot of food in the fridge now — yesterday **there wasn't** anything.
sentences.translation: Hozir muzlatgichda ovqat ko'p **bor** — kecha hech narsa **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: At ten o'clock **there were** a lot of people in the café; now **there are** only two.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda kafeda odam **ko'p edi**, hozir esa faqat ikki kishi **bor**.

sentences.text: Grandma says **there were** more trees in Tashkent when she was young.
sentences.translation: Buvimning aytishicha, uning yoshligida Toshkentda daraxtlar **ko'proq edi**.

sentences.text: This morning **there was** water in the bottle, and now it's empty!
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab shishada suv **bor edi**, hozir esa bo'm-bo'sh!

sentences.text: Before, **there wasn't** a bus stop near our house, but now **there is** one.
sentences.translation: Ilgari uyimiz yaqinida avtobus bekati **yo'q edi**, hozir esa **bor**.

examples.title: **There has been** / **There have been**
examples.description: Present Perfect: **there has been** (qisqa — **there's been**) va **there have been** = «... bo'ldi», «... bo'libdi». Natija hozir muhim yoki davr hali tugamagan.

sentences.text: **There's been** an accident on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistralda **avariya bo'libdi**.

sentences.text: Recently **there have been** a lot of changes at my work.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda ishimda ko'p o'zgarishlar **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: **There has been** no rain here for three months.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda uch oydan beri yomg'ir **yog'magan**.

sentences.text: This week **there have been** three meetings, and it's only Wednesday!
sentences.translation: Bu hafta uchta yig'ilish **bo'ldi**, vaholanki bugun hali chorshanba!

sentences.text: Oh no! **There's been** a mistake — this isn't my order.
sentences.translation: Voy! **Xatolik bo'libdi** — bu mening buyurtmam emas.

sentences.text: Since January **there have been** five new students in our class.
sentences.translation: Yanvardan beri sinfimizga beshta yangi o'quvchi **qo'shildi**.

sentences.text: In Samarkand **there has been** a lot of building work this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Samarqandda ko'p qurilish ishlari **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: **Have there been** any calls for me? — Yes, two.
sentences.translation: Menga **qo'ng'iroq bo'ldimi**? — Ha, ikkita.

sentences.text: **There have been** no problems with the new car so far.
sentences.translation: Hozirgacha yangi mashinada hech qanday muammo **bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Tom says **there have been** strange noises in the flat upstairs all week.
sentences.translation: Tomning aytishicha, butun hafta yuqori qavatdagi kvartiradan g'alati ovozlar **kelibdi**.

examples.title: **there was** ↔ **there has been**
examples.description: Tugagan vaqt (yesterday, last month, ... ago) — **there was**; hozirgacha davom etayotgan davr (this year, since ..., recently) yoki yangi natija — **there has been** (→ 20-dars).

sentences.text: **There was** a lot of snow last winter, but **there hasn't been** any this winter.
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish qor ko'p **yog'di**, bu qish esa hali **yog'magan**.

sentences.text: Yesterday **there was** a power cut for two hours.
sentences.translation: Kecha ikki soat chiroq **o'chdi**.

sentences.text: Since Monday **there have been** two power cuts.
sentences.translation: Dushanbadan beri ikki marta chiroq **o'chdi**.

sentences.text: In 2010 **there was** only one bridge across the river; since then **there have been** three new ones.
sentences.translation: 2010-yilda daryo ustida faqat bitta ko'prik **bor edi**; o'shandan beri yana uchtasi **qurildi**.

sentences.text: **There has been** a lot of rain this month.
sentences.translation: Bu oy yomg'ir ko'p **yog'di**.

sentences.text: Last month **there was** hardly any rain.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy deyarli yomg'ir **yog'madi**.

sentences.text: Listen! **There's been** a change of plan: the meeting is at three now.
sentences.translation: Eshiting! Reja **o'zgardi**: yig'ilish endi soat uchda.

sentences.text: When I lived in London, **there was** a great bakery on my street.
sentences.translation: Londonda yashaganimda ko'chamda ajoyib novvoyxona **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **has there been** any news from the hospital? — Not yet.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, kasalxonadan biror **xabar bo'ldimi**? — Hali yo'q.

sentences.text: Three weeks ago **there was** a fire in our building; since then **there have been** new rules about smoking.
sentences.translation: Uch hafta oldin binomizda **yong'in bo'ldi**; o'shandan beri chekish haqida yangi qoidalar **joriy qilindi**.

examples.title: **There will be** / **There won't be**
examples.description: Kelajak: **there will be** (qisqa — **there'll be**) = «... bo'ladi», inkori **there won't be** = «... bo'lmaydi». Birlik va ko'plikda bir xil.

sentences.text: **There will be** a meeting for all parents on Friday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni barcha ota-onalar uchun yig'ilish **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Tomorrow **there'll be** sun in the morning and rain in the afternoon.
sentences.translation: Ertaga ertalab quyosh **chiqadi**, tushdan keyin esa yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, **there'll be** plenty of food at the party.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olma, bazmda ovqat juda **ko'p bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: **There won't be** any classes on Monday — it's a holiday.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni darslar **bo'lmaydi** — bayram.

sentences.text: Next year **there will be** a new metro line to the airport.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili aeroportga yangi metro liniyasi **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: At the concert **there'll be** famous singers from Uzbekistan and Britain.
sentences.translation: Konsertda O'zbekiston va Britaniyaning mashhur qo'shiqchilari **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: I'm afraid **there won't be** enough chairs for everyone.
sentences.translation: Qo'rqamanki, hammaga stul **yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: In the future **there will be** more electric cars on our roads.
sentences.translation: Kelajakda yo'llarimizda elektromobillar **ko'proq bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Tonight **there's going to be** a full moon.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi to'lin oy **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Hurry up, or **there won't be** any seats left!
sentences.translation: Tezroq bo'l, aks holda bo'sh joy **qolmaydi**!

examples.title: Questions: **Was there**, **Has there been**, **Will there be** ...?
examples.description: Turli zamonlarda savol: **be** yoki yordamchi fe'l **there** dan oldinga chiqadi. Savol — qisqa javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: **Will there be** a toilet on the train? — Yes, **there will**.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda hojatxona **bo'ladimi**? — Ha, **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: **Was there** a doctor on the plane? — Luckily, yes, **there was**.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda shifokor **bormidi**? — Baxtimizga, ha, **bor ekan**.

sentences.text: **Has there been** any post today? — No, **there hasn't**.
sentences.translation: Bugun **pochta keldimi**? — Yo'q, **kelmadi**.

sentences.text: How many people **will there be** at dinner? — Eight, I think.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatda necha kishi **bo'ladi**? — Menimcha, sakkiz kishi.

sentences.text: **Were there** any problems at the border? — No, everything was fine.
sentences.translation: Chegarada biror **muammo bo'ldimi**? — Yo'q, hammasi joyida edi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **will there be** a bus to Chimgan tomorrow morning?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ertaga ertalab Chimyonga avtobus **bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza, **was there** anyone at home when you got back?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, qaytib kelganingda uyda **kimdir bormidi**?

sentences.text: What **will there be** to eat at the wedding? — Plov, of course!
sentences.translation: To'yda nima **ovqat bo'ladi**? — Palov, albatta!

sentences.text: **Have there been** any changes to the timetable? — Yes, one.
sentences.translation: Jadvalga biror **o'zgarish kiritildimi**? — Ha, bitta.

sentences.text: Why **were there** so many police cars outside? — **There was** an accident.
sentences.translation: Nega tashqarida politsiya mashinalari bunchalik **ko'p edi**? — **Avariya bo'ldi**.

examples.title: Mixed: our town — past, present and future
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bir shahar haqida turli zamonlarda — **there was / were**, **there is / are**, **there have been**, **there will be** va savollar.

sentences.text: Fifty years ago **there was** only one school in our town.
sentences.translation: Ellik yil oldin shahrimizda faqat bitta maktab **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Today **there are** six schools and a college.
sentences.translation: Bugun oltita maktab va bitta kollej **bor**.

sentences.text: In the last few years **there have been** big changes in the centre.
sentences.translation: So'nggi bir necha yilda markazda katta o'zgarishlar **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Next spring **there'll be** a new park by the river.
sentences.translation: Kelasi bahorda daryo bo'yida yangi bog' **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: When my parents were young, **there weren't** any cafés here.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam yosh bo'lganida bu yerda kafelar **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Now **there's** a café on almost every corner.
sentences.translation: Hozir deyarli har bir burchakda kafe **bor**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, **there isn't** a cinema in the town any more.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, shaharda endi kinoteatr **yo'q**.

sentences.text: **Will there be** a new cinema? — The mayor says **there will**.
sentences.translation: Yangi kinoteatr **bo'ladimi**? — Hokimning aytishicha, **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Last summer **there was** a big festival in the main square, and **there were** thousands of visitors.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda bosh maydonda katta festival **bo'ldi**, unga minglab mehmonlar **keldi**.

sentences.text: I hope **there'll be** another festival this year!
sentences.translation: Umid qilamanki, bu yil ham festival **bo'ladi**!
